why: Done with git 2.46+'s newer subcommand form: `git config set --global ...` and `git config list --global` instead of `git config --global ...` / `--list`. The list shows user.name, user.email and alias.i=init: the same settings the video makes.

Terminal: tripi@mac ~ % git config set --global user.name "Sam Rivera"
tripi@mac ~ % git config set --global alias.i init
